span.div:
Scenario: 2 full nodes + 1 witness
- Tolerates 1 node failure (witness + 1 full node must survive)
- If a full node fails, the witness provides the third vote
- If the witness fails, the 2 full nodes continue with 2/2 quorum
- Full failure: both full nodes fail → lock service down
- Cost: 60% of a 3-node cluster (2 full + 1 light)
Use case: Cost-sensitive deployments where 3 full nodes is too
expensive but 2 nodes is too risky. Common in staging, DR, or
low-throughput production environments.
